verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a client-side UI framework installed as an MIT-licensed library. It does not host or hold user data, so 'export all of my data and leave' is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Vue operating a service that stores user data, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
